player_0.content: New plan: I prematurely declared "DONE" while in the Sauna, failing to realize that the Game room (accessible via south) had not been fully explored or that other paths from the Bedroom might lead to unvisited rooms. Specifically, after returning to the Sauna from the west, I should have checked if the "south" direction led to a new state or if I had missed exploring the "east" direction from the Bedroom before returning. My mistake was assuming the map was fully covered after a single loop. Next time, I will maintain a mental list of visited rooms and only declare "DONE" when I am in a room where all available directions lead to rooms I have already visited. If I return to a previously visited room (like the Sauna), I will systematically try any untried directions from that room or backtrack to the last room with unexplored options (like the Bedroom's east direction) before concluding.
